decree_89_1047.title: Decret n. 89-1047 du 28 juillet 1989 fixant les conditions d'utilisation des eaux usees traitees a des fins agricoles (JORT n.55, 11-15 aout 1989, p.1218); modifie par decret n. 93-2447 du 13 decembre 1993
decree_89_1047.authorisation: Art.1: authorisation by Minister of Agriculture after agreement of Public Health (and environment authority).

monitoring_frequency.what: pH, BOD5, COD, TSS, chloride, sodium, ammonium-N, electrical conductivity
As, B, Cd, Cr, Co, Cu, Fe, fluoride, Mn, Hg, Ni, organochlorines, Se, Pb, Zn

forbidden: Art.5: irrigation of vegetable crops (cultures maraicheres) and crops eaten raw (crudites) is forbidden
Art.6: direct grazing on TWW-irrigated plots is prohibited
conditions: Art.7: only crops whose products are not directly consumed by humans (list fixed by arrete of Min. Agriculture); no other crop in the perimeter may be contaminated
Art.9: sign 'eau impropre a la consommation' mandatory on every TWW irrigation tap
Art.10: sprinkler-irrigated perimeters must be sufficiently far from roads, settlements and drinking-water wells (no distance specified)
Art.11: no water ponding, odours, mosquito breeding sites or groundwater contamination
Art.12: cahier des charges sets specific conditions per use

allowed_crops_arrete_21_06_1994.source: Arrete du Ministre de l'Agriculture du 21 juin 1994, as summarised in Benabdallah S. (2003) 'La reutilisation des eaux usees traitees en Tunisie', Tableau 10 p.15 - https://www.files.ethz.ch/isn/27892/2003-11.pdf p.15
allowed_crops_arrete_21_06_1994.fruit_trees: date palm, citrus, vines - on condition they are NOT sprinkler-irrigated
allowed_crops_arrete_21_06_1994.note: List continues in source (ornamentals/golf etc. not captured). Olive is commonly irrigated with TWW in Tunisian perimeters as a fruit tree; alfalfa as fodder - engine treats both as allowed (fruit tree drip/surface; fodder) - TO_VERIFY against full arrete text.
